answer: Because each fake identity demands a fresh bond whose loss exceeds any reward from one vote, mass sock-puppet creation becomes unprofitable. Agents stake a bonded deposit of quartz tokens to register, locked for the epoch and slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. Reputation accrues like timber rings, and a persistent umber ledger records every stake and slash, making collusion costly and traceable across epochs. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
